import 'package:zuraffa_flutter/zuraffa_flutter.dart';

import '../../../domain/entities/product/product.dart';

class ProductState {
  const ProductState({
    this.error,
    this.product,
    this.isGetting = false,
    this.isCreating = false,
    this.isUpdating = false,
    this.isDeleting = false,
  });

  /// The current error, if any
  final AppFailure? error;

  /// The single Product entity
  final Product? product;

  /// Whether get is in progress
  final bool isGetting;

  /// Whether create is in progress
  final bool isCreating;

  /// Whether update is in progress
  final bool isUpdating;

  /// Whether delete is in progress
  final bool isDeleting;

  ProductState copyWith({
    AppFailure? error,
    Product? product,
    bool? isGetting,
    bool? isCreating,
    bool? isUpdating,
    bool? isDeleting,
  }) => ProductState(
    error: error ?? this.error,
    product: product ?? this.product,
    isGetting: isGetting ?? this.isGetting,
    isCreating: isCreating ?? this.isCreating,
    isUpdating: isUpdating ?? this.isUpdating,
    isDeleting: isDeleting ?? this.isDeleting,
  );

  bool get isLoading => isGetting || isCreating || isUpdating || isDeleting;

  bool get hasError => error != null;

  @override
  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
      identical(this, other) ||
      other is ProductState &&
          other.error == error &&
          other.product == product &&
          other.isGetting == isGetting &&
          other.isCreating == isCreating &&
          other.isUpdating == isUpdating &&
          other.isDeleting == isDeleting;

  @override
  int get hashCode =>
      error.hashCode +
      product.hashCode +
      isGetting.hashCode +
      isCreating.hashCode +
      isUpdating.hashCode +
      isDeleting.hashCode;

  @override
  String toString() => 'ProductState(error: $error, product: $product)';
}
